source_refs.note: Stars as Black Body Radiators: a main subheading of 21.4 Blackbody Radiation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 173-173.

blocks.text: Stars such as Sun behave like blackbody radiator. They generate and emit their own energy due to nuclear fusion and this energy spreads into space in the form of electromagnetic radiation. The radiation emitted by a star covers a wide range of wavelengths and forms a continuous spectrum without any gaps. This spectrum is similar to a blackbody spectrum. By studying the spectrum, scientists can estimate the surface temperature of the star accurately. As each star has its own spectrum, so its surface temperature is also different.
